name: Created Schedule Details
query:
SELECT
    s.schedule_number AS "Schedule Number:Data:150",
    s.schedule_date AS "Schedule Date:Date:150",
    s.schedule_amount AS "Schedule Amount:Currency:170",
    s.total_rebate AS "Rebate:Currency:120",
    s.total_surcharge AS "Surcharge:Currency:120",

    (s.schedule_amount + s.total_surcharge - s.total_rebate)
        AS "Deposit Amount:Currency:140",

    COUNT(t.name) AS "RD Books:Int:120"

FROM `tabWMS RD Schedule` s
LEFT JOIN `tabWMS RD Transaction` t
    ON t.parent = s.name
    AND t.parenttype = 'WMS RD Schedule'

WHERE s.docstatus = 1
AND s.schedule_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s

GROUP BY s.name
ORDER BY s.schedule_date DESC;
